newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-N.TVL WIN TOSS, FIELD AGAINST NATAL.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-N.TVL WIN TOSS, FIELD AGAINST NATAL.

text.p: Northern Transvaal won the toss and chose to field on the opening day of the four day Supersport Series match between Northern Transvaal and Natal at Centurion Park. Play began late at 11:30 after overnight rain.
Northern Transvaal: Andre Seymore, Martin van Jaarsveld, Roy Pienaar, Richie Richardson, Mike Rindel, Dan van Zyl, Mark Davis (captain), Steve Elworthy, Ivan Pistorius, Pierre Joubert, Rudi Bryson.
Natal: Doug Watson, Rudi Steyn, Errol Stewart, Dale Benkenstein (captain), Neil Johnson, Mark Bruyns, Shaun Pollock, Keith Forde, Anthony Botha, Tertius Bosch, Gary Gilder.
